rubric.fully_supported: expected canonical fact present in answer (normalized containment, numeric tolerance max(0.011, 0.5%)) AND cited page set covers an expectedEvidence (docId,page)
rubric.partially_supported: fact present, citation does not match
rubric.abstained: unanswerable question, abstention pattern or empty answer
rubric.invented: unanswerable question, non-empty answer without abstention marker (conservative)
rubric.failure: arm error/timeout (stays in every denominator as a non-success)
rubric.citations_fts_hybrid: context pages shown to the model (top-6 chunk spans)
rubric.citations_pageindex_arms: pages read via get_page_content + [<file>, p. N] citations parsed from the answer

c1_safety.rejectedNote: page requests the SDK refused before anything entered the evidence (counted, not a violation)

c4_abstention.note: failures counted in n but as not-invented (an error produces no answer); failure counts reported alongside

decision.rule: adopt iff ALL of c1..c6 pass (pi2-criteria.md); quality-only fail -> do-not-adopt; doc-class-only gains -> scope; unsafe/unbuildable -> fail
